title: docs(skills): type-check 14 more objectstack-data examples and fix the Field import path
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb2wtMdjxrW3hze65M5q3BXN)_

Refs #31112 (slice 2 of a per-skill split: item 4, objectstack-data; the card stays open)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:objectstack-data 技能包里又有 14 段 TypeScript 示例接入了示例编译检查(95 段中由 11 段变为 25 段),并修正一处会让照抄者编译失败的示例:`Field` 原写成从 `@objectstack/spec` 根入口导入,根入口并不导出它,改为 `@objectstack/spec/data`。
- 为什么改:AI 编写元数据时最先照抄这些示例;没接入检查的示例在规范改名后会悄悄失效,这次就查出一处已经失效的导入。
- 风险与回滚:只改发布技能包的文档文字,不动任何运行时代码;每个文件的 token 上限都未抬高,新增字节靠同文件删减重复句支付。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`(唯一的示例修正)、`skills/objectstack-data/rules/indexing.md`(8 段新接入、改动最多)、`skills/objectstack-data/rules/validation.md`(删去两句重复说明以支付额度)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`,预期最后一行为 322 段示例全部通过类型检查。
- 需要你做的:作为受管面审批人审阅并批准本 PR(skills/** 属 Tier H)。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-data` had 11 of its 95 fenced `ts`/`typescript` blocks under `check:skill-examples` (measured on `main` 158cc2aa, all `*.md` outside `evals/`, `_index.md` excluded). It now has 25. Every new mark is the os:check marker on the line above the fence; wrappers are an import plus a typed `const`, never more than three lines.

| File | marked before → after / blocks | tokens before → after / ceiling | lines before → after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `rules/indexing.md` | 0 → 8 / 10 | 2284 → 2495 / 3241 | 236 → 260 |
| `references/data-hooks.md` | 1 → 5 / 24 | 9905 → 9987 / 10011 | 942 → 953 |
| `rules/lifecycle.md` | 0 → 1 / 2 | 1588 → 1590 / 1590 | 164 → 165 |
| `rules/field-types.md` | 0 → 1 / 8 | 3199 → 3199 / 3199 | 252 → 253 |
| `rules/validation.md` | 2 → 2 / 15 | 2761 → 2754 / 2761 | 329 → 331 |
| `references/examples-objects.md` | 4 → 4 / 5 | 1710 → 1723 / 1728 | 189 → 191 |
| untouched: `SKILL.md`, `seeds.md`, `datasources.md`, `relationships.md`, `security.md` | 2/4, 0/4, 0/1, 0/13, 2/9 | headroom 9, 0, 3, 0, 0 | unchanged |

Skills bundle reading: no `SKILL.md` changed, so the sum of every published `SKILL.md` stays 4592 lines.

- **`rules/indexing.md`**: eight index examples become `const indexes: ObjectIndex[] = [ … ];` (or `const index: ObjectIndex`) with `import type { ObjectIndex } from '@objectstack/spec/data'`. A retired `type` / `partial` key or an unscoped `unique: true` now fails the gate. The two blocks holding ❌ keys stay unmarked; the opening "Guide for …" line, which carried no rule, now says so.
- **`references/data-hooks.md`**: the full `defineHook` definition is marked as written; patterns 1 to 3 gain their `defineHook` import. Pattern 4 stays unmarked (its `record: any` parameter is a bare `any`, which the gate refuses), as do the context shapes and fragments; the intro says so once.
- **`rules/lifecycle.md`**: the `ObjectSchema.create` syntax block is marked as written, paid by "Guide for declaring" becoming "Declaring". The ❌ block sits under the heading "Validation Rules (rejected at parse time)".
- **`rules/field-types.md`**: the `Field.*` factory block is marked as `const fields = { … };`.
- **`references/examples-objects.md`**: the `protection` type excerpt gets one line saying it is an excerpt and unchecked.

### Example fixes

- `rules/field-types.md:19` (was line 18): `import { Field } from '@objectstack/spec'` does not compile. The spec root exports no `Field`: namespace exports were removed from the root for tree-shaking (`packages/spec/src/index.ts`, "NAMESPACE EXPORTS — REMOVED"), and every example app imports it from `@objectstack/spec/data`. Now `import { Field } from '@objectstack/spec/data'`. The prose at line 12 named the same wrong path, "(`@objectstack/spec`)"; that parenthetical is removed, because the import line right below it now carries the path and the gate checks it.
- `rules/validation.md:325`: the ✅ "Correct — Validation Scoped to Events" example had no `name`, which every validation rule requires (`BaseValidationRuleShape`). It gains `name: 'no_draft_publish'`. The block stays unmarked because it is an object-literal fragment.

### Trims that paid the marks (each cut rule and where it survives)

- `rules/validation.md`, Uniqueness section: "There is **no `unique` validation type**." This survives at "Available Rule Types": "**No `unique` type** — enforce uniqueness with a **unique index**".
- `rules/validation.md`, Cross-Field section: "Same inverted semantics as `script` — the predicate is the **failure** condition." This survives at "Expression Syntax" ("For `script` **and** `cross_field`, the predicate expresses the **failure** condition") and in the block's own `// ❌ TRUE = invalid` comment.
- `rules/field-types.md:11`: "overwhelmingly" became "mostly", and the wrong import parenthetical went (see above).
- `rules/indexing.md:3` and `rules/lifecycle.md:3`: intro wording that carried no rule.

## Tests

<details><summary>check:skill-examples, before and after</summary>

- Before (`main` 158cc2aa): `✅ 308 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)`.
- After (head c4e232fe, the same skills tree as the merged head): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` exited 0 with `✅ 322 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s) — every marked block parsed, so tsc ran the SEMANTIC pass on all of them` (skills + docs surface 274 → 288).
- Reverse check, run after the commit: planted a retired index `type` (`rules/indexing.md:142`), an unknown hook key `runAsUser` (`references/data-hooks.md:747`) and the old root `Field` import (`rules/field-types.md:19`). The checker exited 1 with TS2353, TS2353 and TS2305 at exactly those lines. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- skills/objectstack-data`; `git status --porcelain` was empty after.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `check:skill-examples` is not in the derived gate list for a `skills/**` diff, so it was run by hand.
- Blocks left unmarked because the file has no headroom to pay for a wrapper: `rules/relationships.md` (headroom 0; six `ObjectSchema.create` blocks, which each need an import, and three of them hold two `export default`s), `rules/security.md` (0; the two `rowLevelSecurity` lists), `references/seeds.md` (0; each block names an object defined elsewhere, so it needs a `declare const` line), `rules/datasources.md` (3; the federated-object block needs an import of about 18 tokens), `SKILL.md` (9; the `searchableFields` object and the `indexes` list; the same `indexes` list is checked in `rules/indexing.md`), and the `validations: [ … ]` lists in `rules/validation.md` (about 27 tokens each). The probe that sorted the 95 blocks wrapped each of these with its real type, and every one compiled except the deliberate ❌ examples. So no other example is wrong today; they are just not gated.
- The fragment note is unpaid in those five untouched files, which have 0 to 9 tokens of headroom and no sentence that could go without losing a fact. This is reported as a deviation.
- No ceiling was raised or lowered, and the ratchet printed no instruction to lower one.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 45 families) on head c4e232fe</summary>

44 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package's `dist`; CI runs it). `dispatch-gates --ran` exited 0: 45 derived, 44 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED. After merging `main` (head 1d424c00, which touches no `packages/spec` or `skills/` path), the token ratchet, `check:cross-package-test-inputs` (whose script `main` changed), `check:skill-links` and `check-changeset-no-major` were re-run, all exit 0.
</details>
